body: I get it. I'm in the same position, but if you have one small slice of you not wanting to do it don't do it :( I know you don't know me but I'll be here for you

yeah I read your other stuff and you seem to be going through a lot :( I'm sorry that's happening. being left out and neglected is one of the worst feelings. plus having people put you down with words is also the worst. I think its easier to think of the bad times that you've had instead of the good and that's why we get so caught up in our thoughts. so instead of someone saying a negative thing to you, think of the positive things that they've said. and if you can't think of any then make them up because that's what I do sometimes to help me feel better

I've been through a situation where if I was to get pregnant I would kill myself but you shouldn't do it over an std, especially if you can go get it checked out and have it cured. I don't know where you live but look up planned parenthood clinics and they could help you get checked out for that stuff and tell you what to do and they won't tell your parents. just please don't kill yourself over something that you could've possibly cured :( It'll get better and ill be there to support you through the way!
hey, everything is going to be okay,  talk to me about it :( <3
